question.worked_solution:
Recall that 

- ${max}_{x\in S}g(x)$ is the largest output value, while

- $\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}g(x)$ is an input in $S$ where that largest output occurs.

On the other hand,

- ${min}_{x\in S}g(x)$ is the smallest output value, while

- $\operatorname{arg}⁡{min}_{x\in S}g(x)$ is an input in $S$ where that smallest output occurs.

Here, the outputs are $5,-3,10,$ and $0.$ 

- The largest output is $10,$ and it occurs at $x=6.$

- The smallest output is $-3,$ and it occurs at $x=4.$

Therefore, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{max}_{x\in S}g(x) & =10 \\ \operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}g(x) & =6 \\ {min}_{x\in S}g(x) & =-3 \\ \operatorname{arg}⁡{min}_{x\in S}g(x) & =4\end{aligned}
$$
